gamification.instructions: Create a friendly fantasy mathematics quest for Secondary 3 learners practising coordinate geometry of circles. Keep the story encouraging, age-appropriate, concise, and focused on effort, accuracy, and reflection.
gamification.title: Coordinate Geometry Quest
gamification.description: Build confidence and accuracy while mastering coordinate geometry of circles.
